 Job Scan Home / Income Tax / Lottery Prize Money Attracts 30% Income Tax Irrespective of Classification as Business Income SC Upholds Kerala HC Judgment [Read Order] Income Tax Law Report Lottery Prize Money Attracts 30% Income Tax Irrespective of Classification as Business Income SC Upholds Kerala HC Judgment [Read Order]
 Pro Revenue · More rulings on Business income → 
 Lottery winnings taxable at 30% u/s 115BB of Income Tax Act
 By  Kalyani B. Nair · 2 Nov 2026, 5:45 pm IST 2′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × The Supreme Court upheld the Kerala High Court ruling that the lottery prize money attracts tax at the special rate of 30% under Section 115BB of the Income Tax Act, 1961, irrespective of whether it is classified as business income.
 The respondent-assessee, M/s Manjoo and Company, a wholesale distributor of Kerala State lotteries, received prize money for winning tickets that remained unsold until the draw dates during the assessment years 2000-01 and 2001-02. Although the Lottery Directorate deducted tax at source under the head “winnings from lottery”, the respondent claimed the receipts as business income, contending that they arose from its lottery distribution business. 
 Headnote The case number, coram and counsel for this order are part of the subscriber record.
